title: Be a licensed land auctioneer
what: Carry on business as a land auctioneer only while licensed.

sources.title: Agents Act 2003 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 21(1) (current republication (R45, from 6 December 2025; Agents Act 2003 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person is not a licensed land auctioneer; and (b) the person— (i) carries on business as a land auctioneer

sources.title: Agents Act 2003 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 33, words naming the body (found 19 Nov 2026) (current republication (R45, from 6 December 2025; Agents Act 2003 | Acts)
sources.quote: The commissioner for fair trading must issue the licence if satisfied that the applicant is eligible to be licensed under section 24 (Eligibility for licences).
